houseDescriptions.1: How you enter life situations, take action, and form first impressions.
houseDescriptions.2: How you earn, keep, and value what gives material stability.
houseDescriptions.3: Thinking style, daily communication, and the way you process information.
houseDescriptions.4: Family themes, private space, emotional roots, and inner grounding.
houseDescriptions.5: Self-expression, joy, romance, and personal creative output.
houseDescriptions.6: Daily systems, discipline, work habits, and health-supporting routines.
houseDescriptions.7: One-to-one dynamics, agreements, and balance in committed bonds.
houseDescriptions.8: Transformation, trust, debts, shared assets, and deeper emotional layers.
houseDescriptions.9: Worldview, meaning, higher learning, travel, and expansion of perspective.
houseDescriptions.10: Public role, career path, ambition, and social reputation.
houseDescriptions.11: Communities, long-term goals, and support through alliances.
houseDescriptions.12: Hidden inner processes, retreat, closure, and psychological reset.

aries.title: Sun in Aries
aries.text: Your core identity is driven by courage, initiative, and a pioneering spirit. You lead with action, thrive on challenges, and express yourself boldly. Independence is essential to your sense of self.

taurus.title: Sun in Taurus
taurus.text: Your core identity is rooted in stability, patience, and sensory appreciation. You build lasting foundations, value security, and express yourself through determination and quiet strength.

gemini.title: Sun in Gemini
gemini.text: Your core identity thrives on communication, curiosity, and mental agility. You connect with the world through ideas, adapt easily to new situations, and express yourself with wit and versatility.

cancer.title: Sun in Cancer
cancer.text: Your core identity is shaped by deep emotional sensitivity and nurturing instincts. You protect those you love fiercely, find strength in family bonds, and express yourself through care and intuition.

leo.title: Sun in Leo
leo.text: Your core identity radiates warmth, creativity, and natural leadership. You express yourself with confidence and generosity, thrive in the spotlight, and inspire others through your passionate self-expression.

virgo.title: Sun in Virgo
virgo.text: Your core identity is defined by analytical precision, service to others, and practical wisdom. You improve everything you touch, express yourself through competence, and find purpose in meaningful work.

libra.title: Sun in Libra
libra.text: Your core identity seeks harmony, beauty, and balanced relationships. You express yourself through diplomacy and aesthetic sensibility, and find meaning in creating fairness and connection between people.

scorpio.title: Sun in Scorpio
scorpio.text: Your core identity is driven by emotional depth, transformative power, and unwavering determination. You see beneath the surface, express yourself with intensity, and possess remarkable resilience through life's challenges.

sagittarius.title: Sun in Sagittarius
sagittarius.text: Your core identity is fueled by a quest for truth, adventure, and philosophical understanding. You express yourself with optimism and enthusiasm, and find purpose in expanding horizons through travel and learning.

capricorn.title: Sun in Capricorn
capricorn.text: Your core identity is built on ambition, discipline, and long-term vision. You express yourself through achievement and responsibility, and find fulfillment in building structures that stand the test of time.

aquarius.title: Sun in Aquarius
aquarius.text: Your core identity is shaped by originality, humanitarian vision, and intellectual independence. You express yourself through innovation and progressive ideals, and find purpose in contributing to collective progress.

pisces.title: Sun in Pisces
pisces.text: Your core identity flows through compassion, imagination, and spiritual sensitivity. You express yourself through empathy and creative vision, and find meaning in transcending ordinary boundaries of experience.

aries.title: Moon in Aries
aries.text: Your emotional nature is fiery and impulsive. You process feelings quickly and need excitement and action to feel alive. Emotional independence matters deeply to you.

taurus.title: Moon in Taurus
taurus.text: Your emotional nature craves security and sensory comfort. You process feelings slowly and steadily, finding peace in routine, nature, and physical pleasures.

gemini.title: Moon in Gemini
gemini.text: Your emotional nature is restless and intellectually driven. You process feelings through conversation and mental activity, and need variety and stimulation to feel emotionally balanced.

cancer.title: Moon in Cancer
cancer.text: Your emotional nature is deeply nurturing and intuitive. You feel everything intensely, draw strength from home and family, and have powerful instincts for caring for others.

leo.title: Moon in Leo
leo.text: Your emotional nature is warm, dramatic, and expressive. You need recognition and appreciation to feel emotionally secure, and process feelings through creative self-expression and generosity.

virgo.title: Moon in Virgo
virgo.text: Your emotional nature is analytical and service-oriented. You process feelings through practical action and problem-solving, finding emotional comfort in order, routine, and being useful.

libra.title: Moon in Libra
libra.text: Your emotional nature seeks harmony and partnership. You process feelings through relationships and aesthetic experiences, and need balance and beauty in your emotional environment.

scorpio.title: Moon in Scorpio
scorpio.text: Your emotional nature is intensely deep and transformative. You feel with extraordinary power, process emotions through investigation and introspection, and form bonds of unwavering loyalty.

sagittarius.title: Moon in Sagittarius
sagittarius.text: Your emotional nature is optimistic and freedom-seeking. You process feelings through adventure, philosophy, and humor, and need space and new experiences to feel emotionally alive.

capricorn.title: Moon in Capricorn
capricorn.text: Your emotional nature is reserved and self-reliant. You process feelings through achievement and practical responsibility, finding emotional security in structure and long-term goals.

aquarius.title: Moon in Aquarius
aquarius.text: Your emotional nature is independent and unconventional. You process feelings through intellectual detachment and social idealism, and need freedom and authenticity in emotional connections.

pisces.title: Moon in Pisces
pisces.text: Your emotional nature is deeply empathic and imaginative. You absorb the feelings of those around you, process emotions through creativity and spirituality, and need periods of solitude to recharge.

aries.title: Aries Rising
aries.text: You project an energetic, direct, and assertive first impression. Others see you as confident and action-oriented. Your approach to life is head-first and pioneering.

taurus.title: Taurus Rising
taurus.text: You project a calm, steady, and grounded first impression. Others see you as reliable and composed. Your approach to life is deliberate and sensory-rich.

gemini.title: Gemini Rising
gemini.text: You project a quick-witted, curious, and adaptable first impression. Others see you as communicative and youthful. Your approach to life is through gathering and sharing information.

cancer.title: Cancer Rising
cancer.text: You project a warm, protective, and approachable first impression. Others see you as caring and emotionally attuned. Your approach to life is guided by instinct and emotional intelligence.

leo.title: Leo Rising
leo.text: You project a radiant, confident, and magnetic first impression. Others see you as charismatic and commanding. Your approach to life is creative, generous, and heart-centered.

virgo.title: Virgo Rising
virgo.text: You project a thoughtful, composed, and capable first impression. Others see you as intelligent and detail-oriented. Your approach to life is analytical and improvement-focused.

libra.title: Libra Rising
libra.text: You project a charming, graceful, and diplomatic first impression. Others see you as attractive and socially skilled. Your approach to life prioritizes harmony and fair relationships.

scorpio.title: Scorpio Rising
scorpio.text: You project an intense, magnetic, and perceptive first impression. Others sense your depth and emotional power. Your approach to life is investigative and transformative.

sagittarius.title: Sagittarius Rising
sagittarius.text: You project an enthusiastic, open, and adventurous first impression. Others see you as optimistic and philosophical. Your approach to life is expansive and truth-seeking.

capricorn.title: Capricorn Rising
capricorn.text: You project a serious, capable, and ambitious first impression. Others see you as mature and authoritative. Your approach to life is strategic and goal-oriented.

aquarius.title: Aquarius Rising
aquarius.text: You project an original, independent, and forward-thinking first impression. Others see you as unique and intellectually stimulating. Your approach to life is unconventional and community-minded.

pisces.title: Pisces Rising
pisces.text: You project a gentle, dreamy, and compassionate first impression. Others sense your empathy and spiritual depth. Your approach to life is intuitive and creatively fluid.

aries.title: Midheaven in Aries
aries.text: Your career path calls for leadership, entrepreneurship, and independent action. You are driven to be first and to forge new paths in your professional life.

taurus.title: Midheaven in Taurus
taurus.text: Your career path calls for building lasting value and financial stability. You excel in fields that combine beauty, craftsmanship, and patient accumulation of resources.

gemini.title: Midheaven in Gemini
gemini.text: Your career path calls for communication, versatility, and intellectual engagement. You thrive in roles that involve writing, teaching, media, or connecting people and ideas.

cancer.title: Midheaven in Cancer
cancer.text: Your career path calls for nurturing, protecting, and creating emotional safety. You excel in roles that involve caring for others, building homes, or preserving traditions.

leo.title: Midheaven in Leo
leo.text: Your career path calls for creative expression and visible leadership. You thrive in roles where your personal vision and warmth can inspire and entertain others.

virgo.title: Midheaven in Virgo
virgo.text: Your career path calls for precision, service, and practical problem-solving. You excel in roles that require analytical skill, attention to detail, and genuine helpfulness.

libra.title: Midheaven in Libra
libra.text: Your career path calls for diplomacy, aesthetic creation, and partnership. You thrive in roles that involve justice, design, counseling, or bringing people together.

scorpio.title: Midheaven in Scorpio
scorpio.text: Your career path calls for depth, research, and transformative work. You excel in roles that involve investigation, psychology, finance, or guiding others through profound change.

sagittarius.title: Midheaven in Sagittarius
sagittarius.text: Your career path calls for expansion, teaching, and cross-cultural engagement. You thrive in roles that involve travel, higher education, publishing, or inspiring big-picture thinking.

capricorn.title: Midheaven in Capricorn
capricorn.text: Your career path calls for authority, structure, and long-term planning. You excel in roles that require strategic vision, management expertise, and building enduring institutions.

aquarius.title: Midheaven in Aquarius
aquarius.text: Your career path calls for innovation, social progress, and technological vision. You thrive in roles that involve science, activism, technology, or reimagining how systems work.

pisces.title: Midheaven in Pisces
pisces.text: Your career path calls for creativity, healing, and spiritual service. You excel in roles that involve art, music, healthcare, or helping others connect with something greater than themselves.

conjunction.title: Conjunction
conjunction.text: A powerful merging of planetary energies -- these forces blend and amplify each other, creating a concentrated focus in your chart.

opposition.title: Opposition
opposition.text: A dynamic tension between opposing forces -- this aspect calls for balance and integration of two very different energies in your life.

trine.title: Trine
trine.text: A harmonious flow of energy -- these planets support each other naturally, bringing ease, talent, and grace in the areas they govern.

square.title: Square
square.text: A challenging dynamic that drives growth -- this aspect creates friction that pushes you to develop strength and resilience through effort.

sextile.title: Sextile
sextile.text: An opportunity aspect -- these planets offer supportive connections that activate when you take initiative and make conscious effort.
